K_CC FROM TRIAL 1, offline on the curve refitted on both drains (dd5c94fdd9's, on the board and in flash 2) at the raw estimates: L(start) = curve(3482) = 17.65 pm; L(60 min) = curve(3652) = 86.00 pm; D = 60 min of full-white drain = 1000/50.56 = 19.78 pm; charge 2398 s = 0.6661 h. K_CC = (86.00 - 17.65 + 19.78) / 0.6661 = 132.3 pm/h; with +-2 mV at both ends and +-5 pm of curve error, 122-142. CROSS-CHECK BY RUNTIME, using the curve only at the start: 5.388 h of full white from the unplug to the RGB cut is 1000 * 5.388 / 50.56 = 106.6 pm at the unplug, so (106.6 - 17.65) / 0.6661 = 133.5 pm/h. The two agree within 1.2 pm/h.

TRIAL 1 CONTRADICTS B1'S BOUND (165-213 pm/h, from assuming 70-90% of a charge goes in before the knee): 133 is ~20% below its bottom, beyond the uncertainty. NOT the charge current: the charging 5C rose 59.4 -> 71.5 in 20 min here, against 58.9 -> 69.9 on 10-01 and 59.3 -> 70.2 on 10-04, all at led 1000 (the same current, within ~10%). Deviations from the plan's procedure: the start was 1.8%, below the 5-8% band (JD restarted from 2% after the first try was lost), and the two start readings were ~13 min apart, not 5 -- their difference, 3.7 pm on the curve, matches 13 min of full-white drain (4.3 pm). One trial, so the plan's rule stands: trial 2 before any model change.

RELAX_S, from the trajectory: the level at the unplug that each reading implies (curve + full-white drain since the unplug) falls 115-116 pm (6-10 min), ~112 (15 min), ~109 (30 min), ~106 (60 min), ~103 (120 min), against 106.6 by runtime to the cut. A re-seat at 6-10 min would read ~1 point high, at 15 min ~0.6, at 30 min ~0.3; past ~60 min the drift is inside the curve's +-5 pm. The first 6 min, where relaxation is fastest, is not filmed, so 120 s (the initial RELAX_S) cannot be judged from this trial except that it would be >= 1 point high.
